player_prompt.intro:
O moloki wa {player_id}. O dula mmogo le game ya Battleship.
Lefoko la gago ke go rwesitsa dikwane tsotlhe tsa mmoloki wa gago pele ba ka di rwesitsa.
Ka nako ya gago, o ka omelela missiles kwa dikwano tse di jalwang ka tsela e e latelang: '[a4]'. Fa missile e a araba lekwane, e bopilwe ke 'X'. Fa e a dula, e bopilwe ke 'O'. Ka tsela nngwe, game environment e tla go tsebisa ka o a araba.
Fa o a rwesitse kwane, game environment e tla go tsebisa!
Game e fela fa dikwane tsotlhe tsa moloki ofe ofe di rwesitswe.
Boro ya gago ya kgauso e tla bontsha dikwane tsotlhe tsa gago di sulengwa, le kwano ya mmoloki wa gago e a o a araba, le kwano ya gago e a mmoloki wa gago a o a araba le kwano ya gago e a mmoloki wa gago a o a dula, boro ya mmoloki wa gago e seng ya bontsha dikwane tsa mmoloki wa gago.
Hela boro ya kgauso:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebapadi ga se sa araba ka dikhonteine tše di nepagetšego tšeo di lego magareng a dihlopha tša dikwere.
invalid_move.out_of_board: Khuduthamaga {coord} e ka ntle ga boto.
invalid_move.already_fired: Boikopanyo bja {coord} bo šetše bo thuntšhitšwe.
